text:
riley: Heads-up 1: were launching an OSS codelab + companion webinar next Wed. Need: launch post, short benchmark narrative, webinar page copy (2 headlines), and inbound lead routing to HubSpot. Who picks what?
sam: Ill take the launch post + benchmark blurb. Will draft a plain-language summary and a dev takeaway tweet.
anya: I can set up form -> HubSpot mapping, UTM params, and lead scoring rules. Any special fields we need?
morgan: Ill write webinar page copy and two headline variants for an A/B test. Also want a single-line chart blurb: "median p95 latency down X%; cost/unit Y" for the page.
riley: Nice. Sam please make the benchmark digestible: workload (chat completions), models compared (open model + quantized runner), p50/p95 latencies, and cost per 1k tokens. Keep it non-jargon.
sam: Draft up: https://github.com/redwood/oss-codelab/pull/77 includes launch post + benchmark table + 40-word dev-takeaway. Will paste tweet blurb in PR comments.
anya: Routing plan: form -> HubSpot form id 9876, utm_source=oss_codelab, utm_campaign=oss_launch_jun. Tagging logic: ```
// tag based on role
if (role === "engineer") { tag = "eng" }
else if (role === "product") { tag = "pm" }
else { tag = "other" }
```
morgan: Headline options: A) "Hands-on: build a low-latency chat refapp with Redwood" B) "Ship a production-ready chat app: OSS codelab + live benchmarks" Leaning A. CTA: "Register to join the build + see live benchmarks."
riley: Two quick asks: 1) Sam: 1-sentence developer takeaway for tweet (30-40 words). 2) Anya: add tracking snippet on webinar reg page and confirm a test lead appears in HubSpot before publish.
sam: Tweet draft added to PR. Example: "Build a low-latency chat app in one sessionSee how we shave p95 latency and costs using open models + RedwoodJoin the live codelab: [link]"
anya: Adding tracking now. Will post screenshot of test lead in HubSpot in this thread when done.
deploy-bot: Reminder: webinar page deploy scheduled for 2024-06-04T20:00Z unless blocked.
riley: Plan to publish launch post + deploy Tuesday morning so emails can go out. Sam, tag PR with final copy by EOD. Anya, confirm tracking. Morgan, finalize headline A/B + select primary.
morgan: Picking A as primary. Will drop alt headline into PR comments.
sam: Final copy pushed. Ping me for wording tweaks.
anya: Test lead received in HubSpot (screenshot uploaded). Tracking verified.
riley: Sweet 85: proceed to schedule emails. Checklist in PR. :thumbsup:
